subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

I was __startled __by his entry into the hall.
solution:
The correct answer is “**Frightened**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• '**Startled**' means to feel sudden shock or alarm. (चौंक जाना)

 
 
• **Example**- The sudden noise startled her.
 
 
 
• '**Frightened**' refers to the feeling of fear, dread, or apprehension. (डरा हुआ) 
 
 
• **Example**- He was frightened by the sudden appearance of a snake in his path.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is Similar in meaning to 'Startled' is 'Frightened’.

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 3**’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• '**Glad**' means pleased; delighted. (प्रसन्न)
 
• '**Cherished**' means kept fondly in the mind; treasured. (प्यारे) 
 
• '**Miserable**' means very unhappy or uncomfortable. (दुखी)
